title: Cardinals EDGE BJ Ojulari: I can be a double-digit sack guy, have to showcase it

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cardinals EDGE BJ Ojulari: I can be a double-digit sack guy, have to showcase it
sources.description: Cardinals edge rusher BJ Ojulari returned from a torn ACL to play in eight games last season, but the 2023 second-round pick didn't feel all the way back from the injury that wiped out his second NFL season in August.
